channel.title: GFIC Crew (GFIC歪果社)
channel.description: GFIC Crew (GFIC歪果社) is a growing real-life social community for expats in China, founded by locals who know the country well. We meet up in person in Guangzhou and Shenzhen, and we run online groups plus a national WeChat group that expats in any Chinese city can join. We keep ten meetup formats on the board, led by bar nights and pub crawls, food crawls and language exchange.

item.title: Guangzhou expat living guide
item.description: A practical living guide for expats in Guangzhou: visas and residence permits, apartment rental and district prices, banking and WeChat Pay, healthcare, transport, Cantonese food, language and a social scene built on ten meetup formats, from bar nights and pub crawls, food crawls and language exchange through to hiking trips and culture workshops.
